verdicts.catacomb: FAIL — majors: seed1 top-center room floor covered in high-contrast yellow-brown crack noise on every tile; walkways littered with pebbles, skulls, bones, moss; darker grey floor band at room transitions; side doorways stamp 3-tile front-wall strips onto floor; pillars/candelabras/benches float mid-room; minors: reuses castle walls with weak theme separation; flat iron grates in corridors
verdicts.cave: FAIL — majors: heavy salt-and-pepper speckle and vertical dark streaks on every dirt tile, unblended rectangular tan dirt patches with sharp grid edges; turquoise crystals blocking narrow paths; three grates and a rug on lakeshore; south walls lack bottom border; minors: disconnected 1-tile bridges
verdicts.forest: FAIL — majors: camp props (drying racks, barrels, chests, logs, cairns) dropped randomly across lawn; tree bases along cluster south edges have hard rectangular cutoffs; 1x3 rectangular water trench by seed2 pond; minors: visible 16px grass grid repeat; hollow oak without root blending
verdicts.ice: FAIL — majors: cracked-ice zones busy high-contrast crack web with 16px repetition meeting snow along jagged unblended staircase seams; a row of 9 ice crystals fencing the main floor (seed1); desert eye statue on snow; minors: snow mounds/rocks in corridor bottlenecks
verdicts.mine: FAIL — majors: extreme floor noise from speckled brown dirt mixed with sharp-edged rectangular grey gravel patches; boulders/ore/skulls strewn on top; fence/bridge strip over the minecart track; minors: vertical corridor sides lack wall faces; support beams flat on north walls
verdicts.otherworld: FAIL — majors: purple floor with repetitive red slash speckles on every tile and raw rectangular grey flagstone patches; bones/skulls on paths; rectangular starry void pits cut abruptly with bones overlapping; jagged purple brick wall steps; minors: skeleton pillars floating
verdicts.pyramid: FAIL — majors: every sandstone tile has heavy dark-brown crack lines, broken by unblended stepped pale-sand patches cutting cobbles mid-tile; 2x1 front-wall bricks on floor; castle grates on corridor floor; minors: pillars/sarcophagi/beetles floating mid-room
verdicts.ruins: FAIL — majors: halls covered in repetitive green vine/crack pattern on every flagstone with rubble, colliding at raw 16px seams with plain cream tiles; pillars/chest clip the sun mosaic; side doorways place 3-tile wall strips on floor; minors: flat iron grate
verdicts.swamp: FAIL — majors: olive mud blotched with high-contrast pale yellow-green rectangular/cross-shaped grass patches with sharp 16px edges, plus goblets, bamboo posts, bones on open mud; bridges on dry mud; rigid square puddles; minors: flat base cutoffs on perimeter conifers
verdicts.tower: FAIL — majors: isolated cream square tiles like holes in dark grey brick floor; woven brown floor meets grey flagstone at raw seam; bookshelves floating mid-room blocking magic circle; stepped front-wall bricks on seed2 passage with floating flame; minors: spiral stair post flat cutoff
verdicts.volcano: FAIL — majors: ash floor broken by sharp rectangular tan dirt patches, grid-aligned orange cracks, smoking vents across walkways; lava uses high-contrast 16px scale/eye repeat; lava clips into furnace top; minors: grates on dirt floor; 1-tile grey steps don't bridge lava
